Name: Xiddav's Parks - Mountain and Mines
Author: xiddav
Description:
Edit Mountain, Mine, Mine 20/60/100, Quarry Mine, Science House, Maru's Basement, and adds a new area with an abandoned mine.

The Dwarf sells prismatic shards
Adventures Guild sells Tents and Cookout Kits

There are three new Dwarf NPCs, but they don't do anything yet.




It should be compatible with east scarp

[b]Does it work with SVE?[/b]
I didn't test it, but most likely no.
[b]Will you make it compatible with SVE?[/b]
no
[b]Will you make it compatible with [u](insert mod other then SVE)[/u]?[/b]
maybe. I can look into it and see if it's possible.




[b]Thing I am thinking about doing in the future[/b]:
make the old mine shack repairable (It currently repairs when you reach 10 hearts with George, but I want to make it a quest)
add notes around the map
turn the deep abandoned mine into a dwarf village (started)
